Extracts keywords, author, viewport, generator, theme-color, robots, lang, dir metadata

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::{scrape, shutdown_engine};
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine = create_engine(None).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = scrape(&engine, &url).await.expect("call failed");
    shutdown_engine(engine).await;
    println!("{:?}", result.status_code);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.title);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.canonical_url);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.keywords);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.author);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.viewport);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.generator);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.theme_color);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.robots);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.html_lang);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.html_dir);
}
```
